name: Return to formation
summary: Schedule a return to the current formation after preceding reservations.
requirements: Requires Data for AI access to own units and movement plans. The target must belong to a formation and be a controllable follower. This must be its final reservation operation. Replace existing reservations to request a return without first completing them.
